related.title: PostgreSQL WAL：先寫日誌與 redo 邊界
related.titleEn: PostgreSQL WAL: write-ahead ordering and redo boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：以兩連線觀察 WAL 模式的讀者與寫者並行，確認 checkpoint 不能破壞舊讀者。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Observe readers and writers with two WAL connections and verify checkpoints preserve old snapshots. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 以 LSN 簡化模型推演三個當機點，判斷頁面更新是否可復原。
related.differenceEn: Use a simplified LSN model to analyze three crash points and recoverability.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: WAL 追加已變更頁，讀者記住 end mark；checkpoint 受仍在使用舊 WAL 範圍的讀者限制。 教學基準：32+12*(4096+24) = 49472 modeled WAL bytes；第二檢核：12*4096 = 49152 page payload bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
資料頁落盤前，其對應 redo 日誌必須持久化；本課只示範 redo 順序，不實作完整 PostgreSQL recovery。 教學基準：10+5+5 = 20 recovered count；第二檢核：120-100 = 20 modeled LSN gap。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: WAL appends changed pages and readers retain end marks; checkpoints are constrained by readers using older WAL ranges. Teaching baseline: 32+12*(4096+24) = 49472 modeled WAL bytes; second check: 12*4096 = 49152 page payload bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

A page must not become durable before its redo log; this lesson models ordering rather than full PostgreSQL recovery. Teaching baseline: 10+5+5 = 20 recovered count; second check: 120-100 = 20 modeled LSN gap. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Build a hash table on the small relation and probe with the large one,then analyze capacity-driven partitioning.

Hash join 依 join key 配對；重複鍵保留所有匹配，記憶體成本取決於 build 端及 overhead。 教學基準：50000*(32+24) = 2800000 modeled hash bytes；第二檢核：ceil(2800000/(2*1024*1024)) = 2 ideal capacity partitions。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Hash joins match join keys and preserve duplicates; memory depends on the build side and overhead.
